bio.text: Cecilia Aguiar-Curry was elected to the California Assembly in November 2016 to represent the 4th District, which includes all of Napa, Lake, Yolo and Colusa Counties and part of Sonoma County.
She grew up in western Yolo County and served as a planning commissioner and city council member in Winters before becoming its first female mayor.
She has a degree in business administration from San Jose State University, launched a consulting firm specializing in public outreach with government agencies, and lives in Winters.
